issues.explanation: The tickets table has no timestamps columns while the Ticket model uses Eloquent timestamps, so every insert (IssueTicket, factory) fails with an unknown column error.
The type hint `App\Models\User` inside namespace App\Models resolves to `App\Models\App\Models\User`, so calling `call($user)` with a real User throws a TypeError.
The change ships no tests at all, although the conventions require test-first work and coverage of every requirement and failure path.
`call()` never checks that the user is a member of the ticket's entity and never throws AuthorizationException, so any user can call any ticket.
The contract requires `Entity::queues()` (has many), and it is not in the diff.
The default factory sets `code` to null against a NOT NULL column and only `forQueue` allocates a code, so `Ticket::factory()->create()` fails instead of allocating the next code at creation time.
The attempts argument of `DB::transaction` only retries on deadlocks or concurrency errors, not on a unique `(queue_id, code)` violation, so the required collision retry is not implemented.
The code is computed when the state is resolved, before any insert, so `forQueue($q)->count(2)->create()` gives both tickets the same code and hits the unique constraint.

The write-once guard throws on any assignment to a protected field, even an unchanged value, rather than on a save that changes it, and it does not cover the fill/update paths the way a dirty check in a model event would.

The doc update inserts `//` comment lines into the ER diagram (the second is misplaced under `priority`) and documents neither the queues table nor called_at/called_by_user_id; CHANGELOG.md is not updated either.
There are unused imports (DB, Log, User), redundant same-namespace imports and an inline FQCN return type, which is inconsistent with the imported HasMany.

review.summary: The change adds migrations, Queue/Ticket models, enums, the IssueTicket action, factories and some doc updates for queue ticket issuance. It cannot work as written: the tickets table has no timestamps, so every insert fails, and `call()` has a mis-namespaced type hint and no membership authorization. `Entity::queues()`, the collision retry and a working default ticket factory are missing, and there are no tests, so it needs substantial rework.
